recipe.name: nif s breakfast to go  sandwich  oamc
recipe.ingredients: eggs, english muffins, bacon, cheese slices
recipe.steps: 1. there are a few different ways that you can cook the eggs 2. i pierced each yolk , gently stirred each of them and used a plastic egg cooker in the microwave 3. or you can lightly scramble each egg in a cup sprayed with cooking spray 4. or you can lightly scramble each egg in a silicon muffin tin and bake them 5. or you can lightly scramble each egg and cook in a tiny frying pan 6. it's up to you how to cook them ! you basically want them to end up being cooked through and slightly smaller than the size of the english muffin 7. while eggs are cooking , open each english muffin and lay them out 8. when the eggs are done , place each egg on the bottom half of the muffin 9. add bacon to each muffin and top with cheese 10. wrap each breakfast sandwich in plastic wrap 11. i placed the sandwiches in a large resealable bag and put them in the freezer 12. when cooking , placed wrapped sandwich in the microwave 13. microwave on high for 30 to 45 seconds 14. unwrap , turn over and cook on high for another 30 to 45 seconds 15. the cooking time varies on how frozen the sandwich is and the microwave
recipe.description: i wanted to come up with something for my boys to grab for breakfast when they are rushing to get to the school bus. these turned out really well and froze perfectly. the best part? my kids like them! the instructions are incredibly easy - the first step is long because i give options on how to cook the eggs. enjoy!
recipe.explanation: С этим блюдом легко снижать вес легко и вкусно. Оно содержит 18 г белка при калорийности 332 ккал (хорошая порция белка, приятно низкая калорийность).

recipe.name: o  j   yogurt shake
recipe.ingredients: milk, yogurt, frozen orange juice concentrate, ice cubes
recipe.steps: 1. place the milk , yogurt and orange juice concentrate in a blender 2. process until well blended 3. with blender running , gradually add ice cubes through feed cap 4. process until smooth 5. serve immediately
recipe.description: this is a yummy and healthy drink that the kids really enjoy!
recipe.explanation: Мы выбрали этот рецепт, так как он поможет комфортно худеть без чувства голода. В одной порции содержится 127 ккал и 4 г белка (приятно низкая калорийность).

recipe.name: chicken   broccoli bow tie pasta salad
recipe.ingredients: farfalle pasta, fresh broccoli florets, cooked chicken, grape tomatoes, light italian dressing, light cheddar cheese, monterey jack cheese, parmesan cheese
recipe.steps: 1. cook pasta according to directions 2. add broccoli to the cooking water of the pasta during the last 4 minutes of the pasta cooking time 3. drain pasta and broccoli 4. toss chicken , tomatoes , dressing , monterey and cheddar cheese together in a large salad bowl 5. add pasta mixture 6. mixing lightly 7. sprinkle top with parmesan cheese
recipe.description:
from kraft foods with some modifications.  a nice main meal salad.  this can be made ahead and served chilled as a cold salad or made and served immediately as a hot salad.  i prefer the hot salad.  (kraft recommends using 6 oz of their grilled chicken strips but i prefer fresh chicken over packaged - use what you are most comfortable serving).
***update*** based on the review i wanted to let you know what i took out of the original recipe - it called for 1/2 c sliced olives. i was thinking if you want a really strong flavor - try a very zesty italian dressing or saute your chicken with garlic and add chopped onions to the final dish.  maybe that would perk it up for those that like things a bit spicier. the original way is a method in which my kids will eat it but i understand how adults may want a bit more zing.***
recipe.explanation: Мы выбрали этот рецепт, так как он поможет снижать вес легко и вкусно. В одной порции содержится 500 ккал и 42 г белка (отличное количество белка).

recipe.name: easy chicken and garlic potatoes
recipe.ingredients: potatoes, onion, skinless chicken breast halves, dried tarragon, rubbed sage, salt, pepper, bulb of garlic, olive oil
recipe.steps: 1. place potatoes and onion in a greased 13-in 2. x 9-in 3. x 2-in 4. baking dish 5. top with chicken 6. combine tarragon , sage , salt if desired and pepper 7. sprinkle over chicken 8. cut the top off the garlic bulb so each clove is exposed 9. place cut side up in the baking dish 10. drizzle oil over garlic and chicken 11. cover and bake at 350 degrees f for 60 minutes 12. uncover and bake 15 minutes longer or until chicken juices run clear and garlic is soft 13. transfer chicken to a serving platter and keep warm 14. cool garlic for 5 minutes 15. gently squeezed garlic into a small bowl and lightly mash 16. toss garlic with potatoes and onion 17. arrange around chicken
recipe.explanation: Рекомендуем этот вариант, чтобы снижать вес легко и вкусно. Баланс нутриентов отличный: 316 ккал и 30 г ценного белка (отличное количество белка, приятно низкая калорийность).
